Mod.title: Era's UI Improvements
Mod.description: A better trooper Customization screen: pick weapons and gear for every slot (including Trooper Toolbox slots) from a compact grid of icons grouped by type, hide slots the trooper has nothing for, choose any portrait from a grid, see breaching gear (lockpick, crowbar, halligan) in the trooper hover tooltip, and a themed mouse cursor. Requires the DK2 native mod loader.
Mod.author: Gabriel Bunselmeyer
